headline: Findlay take the season series from Kentucky Wesleyan
dek: Saturday's win was Findlay's thirteenth of the season, more than any other programme has managed, though Lake Erie still top the table. Kentucky Wesleyan had beaten them in September; Findlay have won both meetings since.
